newsitem.title: USA: Insurer Nationwide plans public offering - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Insurer Nationwide plans public offering - WSJ.

text.p: Nationwide Insurance Enterprise is thinking about selling a 20-percent stake in its life insurance unit through an initial public offering, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
Citing people close to the matter, the newspaper said the insurer had been discussing the idea with investment bankers for weeks and could file a registration statement within a month.
It said the offering would raise hundreds of millions of dollars that the insurer needed to finance its expansion plans.
Nationwide is owned by policymakers and not shareholders.
Its status would not change since it would be the major owner of any new publicly traded life operation.
